skills.name: Quick Draw
skills.description:
Clint fires 5 bullets in quick succession in the target direction, each dealing 250<font color='#D58E1F'>( +85% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to the enemy hit.
The bullets will spread evenly across enemies in a fan-shaped area. Enemies hit by multiple bullets will take less damage after the first bullet.
skills.tips: This skill has a powerful effect, but is relatively situational and has a small range. Use it to limit enemy movement and trigger Clint's passive.

skills.name: Trapping Recoil
skills.description:
Clint shoots a trap net in the target direction, slightly jumping back while dealing 140<font color='#D58E1F'>( +30% Total Physical Attack)</font><font color='#27C0C7'>( +150% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to the first enemy hit and immobilizing them for 1.2s.
Successfully hitting an enemy reduces the cooldown of this skill by 40%.
skills.tips: Clint can fire this backwards when being chased, and can also use it to jump through walls. Has a wide range of applications.

skills.name: Grenade Bombardment
skills.description:
Clint launches a grenade in the target direction that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing 280<font color='#D58E1F'>( +100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> and slowing them by 25% for 1.2s.
Clint gains a grenade charge every 12s (up to 5).
skills.tips: High single-target damage and can be used frequently. Make sure you're stocked up on grenades before entering a team fight!

skills.name: Double Shot
skills.description: After each skill cast, Clint's next Basic Attack within 4s penetrates a line of enemies, dealing 50<font color='#D58E1F'>( +120% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font>. This damage can trigger attack effects, and the part affected by Physical Attack can Crit.
skills.tips: This is a very strong passive, and helps with sustainability in the laning phase, as well as reaching squishier back-row heroes.

items.name: Endless Battle
items.des: Unique Passive - Divine Justice: After casting a skill, the next Basic Attack within 3s deals 60% Physical Attack as extra True Damage (1.5s cooldown).

items.name: Berserker's Fury
items.des: Unique Passive - Doom: Critical strikes grant 5% extra Physical Attack for 2s.

items.name: Great Dragon Spear
items.des: Unique Passive - Supreme Warrior: After casting an Ultimate, increase Movement Speed by 15% for 7.5s. This effect has a 15s cooldown.

items.name: Malefic Roar
items.des: Unique Passive - Armor Buster: When attacking an enemy, gains 0.125% extra Physical Penetration for each point of the enemy's Physical Defense, capped at 40%.

items.name: Rose Gold Meteor
items.des: Unique Passive - Lifeline: When taking damage that reduces HP below 30%, gain a 420-910 shield (increases with level) and 50% Movement Speed that rapidly decays over 3s. This effect has a 60s cooldown.

builds.tips: The first big priority here is Berserker's Fury, followed by Endless Battle. Maintain your position in the back row and frequently use skills to trigger Quick Draw and Endless Battle's passive effect. Deadly Blade can limit the enemy's ability to retaliate.
